note: Starter island landform (docs/08), built by src/world/terrain/landform.js for chunks -1..1. Meters, Y-up, sea level 0. radius: coast distance from the center before noise. Shore profile: a smooth ramp from the waterline up to plateauHeight over inlandWidth, and down to seabedDepth over seaFallWidth, meeting the waterline at beachSlope (rise per meter). coast: noise that wobbles the coastline (amount in meters). warp: domain warp of the shape fields (strength in meters). detail: gentle fbm bumps on land (amplitude in meters). rise: the central hill (its peak is about plateauHeight + height). basin: a pond hollow with a flat floor at floor meters above sea level. jitter: how far the seed may move the rise or basin center. Everything beyond falloffEnd meters from the center is exactly seabedDepth. materials: sand below sandLow fading to grass by sandHigh (heights in meters, jittered by noise), soil patches where soil noise passes soilLow..soilHigh, rock outcrops only above rockMinHeight where rock noise passes rockLow..rockHigh.

spring.note: The starter spring (docs/07): fromBasinM meters from the basin center toward the rise, so its stream runs down into the pond hollow. rateLps in liters per second. channel: the soft swale the stream has cut from the spring to the pond (width and depth in meters), with a narrow V-shaped thalweg along its middle where the water gathers; meanderM swings it sideways in `bends` full bends, plus the domain warp.
